messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created (SEV: 2) — Smart routing: cost-priority policy routed >60% traffic to quantized-low-cost variant; downstream quality regressions reported by multiple customers. Root cause suspected in new policy rollout.
oncall_jordan: Saw the alert at 09:12 — multiple user reports for hallucinations and truncated answers. Dashboard spike in user-reported QA failures. Bumping to pager.
sre_paul: I'm on it. Can someone paste the exact routing policy that rolled out? I want to check thresholds and compat rules.
eng_ana: Pasting rollout snippet we pushed earlier this morning:
```json
{
  "policy_name": "cost_priority_v2",
  "conditions": {"latency_slo_ms": 200, "cost_weight": 0.8},
  "fallbacks": ["model-A.quantized-8bit", "model-A.fp16"],
  "auto_promote": true
}
```
support_liz: Customer ACME and two other accounts reported clear quality regressions starting ~09:10, total ~1.7k requests affected so far. ACME says answers are shorter and omit steps.
pm_ravi: Impact looks customer-visible -> we should rollback routing policy and pin to last-known-good. Agreed?
oncall_jordan: Yes. Plan: 1) Pause cost_priority_v2 rollout 2) Force-route traffic to model-A.fp16 3) Monitor error/quality metrics 4) Notify customers. Who can run the pin now?
infra_kate: I can run the CLI. Command to force model override:
```
redwoodctl routes override --route-id=prod-global --model=model-A.fp16 --reason="incident 1848000000"
```
sre_paul: Execute that. Also set a temporary rate limit to reduce bursty misclassifications while we validate.
infra_kate: Running override now... output: `OK — route override applied (txn 0x7f3b)`
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Route override applied by infra_kate at 09:28. Previous policy paused.
eng_ana: Good. I'm rolling a small eval suite against a representative prompt set to confirm quality difference. Running now, will post results in 10m.
support_liz: I've emailed ACME with a heads-up that we're remediating and will follow up with RCA. They replied: "Appreciate the quick response. Please advise when fixed." They asked for ETA.
pm_ravi: ETA: 30-45 minutes to confirm then we can de-escalate if metrics look stable. Keep them updated.
eng_ana: Eval results: model-A.fp16 median answer length +15%, QA score +22% compared to quantized variant on our golden set. Looks like regression introduced by quantized variant selection.
sre_paul: Re-enable traffic gradually to validate: keep override for production until rollout config is fixed. We should also block auto_promote flag in policy rollout jobs.
oncall_jordan: Agreed. Change: disable auto_promote and set cost_weight -> 0.4 as a safer default. eng team, can you push config change and run a dry-run before re-enabling?
eng_ana: I'll push the change to staging first and run canary tests. Proposed config diff attached:
```diff
- "cost_weight": 0.8
- "auto_promote": true
+ "cost_weight": 0.4
+ "auto_promote": false
```
infra_kate: Also added a guard in routing engine to ensure variant acceptability checks (min_length, hallucination_score) pass before selecting low-cost variants.
incident-bot: Paging handoff: oncall_jordan -> sre_paul at 10:00 for post-mitigation monitoring window.
sre_paul: Taking handoff. I'll keep the override and monitor 10:00-11:00. If stability holds, we'll start a staged rollout with stricter acceptance.
pm_ravi: Post-incident customer note draft: "We identified a routing policy change that prioritized a quantized low-cost model for a subset of requests, resulting in degraded output quality for some customers. Traffic has been pinned to the prior model and a fix to policy thresholds and automated rollout checks is in progress."
support_liz: Sending that to impacted customers now.
eng_ana: Action items for postmortem: 1) Add canary quality checks that run golden prompts during rollout 2) Add a hard limit on auto_promote for cost-driven policies 3) Improve rollback automation to unroll policies faster 4) Expand alerting to include sudden drop in median answer length.
pm_ravi: Also include business impact: list of impacted customers and duration. Support, please compile.
support_liz: ACME affected from ~09:10 to 09:28 (18m). Other accounts: BetaCo (~25m), TestLabs (~12m). I'll add exact counts to the postmortem.
sre_paul: Metrics look stable after override. No new customer complaints in the last 15m. Keeping monitoring on for full hour.
oncall_jordan: Thanks team. If anything new pops, tag #incidents and I'll jump back in.
incident-bot: Incident 1848000000 status -> Mitigated. Priority: SEV2. Timeline and postmortem draft to follow in #postmortems.
infra_kate: Filed infra PR to add acceptance gates and a toggle to disable auto_promote per-policy. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789
eng_ana: I'll author the postmortem draft with the technical root cause and remediation steps. Targeting draft by end of day.
pm_ravi: Good. Closing the pager handoff to sre_paul. Please add any lingering open items to the postmortem.
sre_paul: Acknowledged. Monitoring continues until 11:00.
support_liz: Final note — ACME is happy with the quick fix. They'll be on a follow-up call tomorrow for RCA. :thumbsup:
